description: Uploads an image (max 2MB; JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP) and returns a hosted HTTPS URL for use as a banner image or inline article image. Provide either a local file path or base64 content plus a filename. When type is "banner" the image must match a supported banner dimension (728x90, 300x250, 120x600, 160x600, 468x60, 336x280, 250x250, 851x315, 650x400, 800x82, 234x60, 125x125, 300x200, 120x240, 240x400, 150x60). Requires a paid membership (Bronze/Silver/Gold); returns an error for free accounts.

base64.description: Base64-encoded image content. Provide together with filename. Ignored if file_path is set.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative local path to the image file to upload.

filename.description: Filename to use when uploading base64 content (e.g. 'banner.png').

type.description: Image category: 'banner' (must match a supported ad size) or 'article'.

name: upload_image
title: Upload an image
